assessments.rationale: Rule 9 flags: FRS-STALE is dismissed (rule 5). Its only target window is the prototype (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04), which is itself historical, so the rule read it as stale for a window that is historical by design. The window is fully covered by the file for N1 (NO2), and it also covers N3 temperature and humidity. overall_rationale: Every must need (N1, N2, N3) has at least one source that meets it with conditions, so the overall verdict is feasible_with_conditions rather than not_feasible. N1 is served by the UCI prototype file (research-only licence to clear with Legal) and the city station readings for production (access approval and VR-03 exclusion). N2 is served only by the Mobility Office traffic counts, which need the 2024-03-18 counter adjustment and a station mapping. N3 is served by Open-Meteo for production (Valdena location and Legal sign-off) and by the UCI file and ARPA Lombardia temperature for the prototype. N4 (should) is met with conditions; N5 (could) is unmet because policy allows only aggregates; N6 (could) is partial, context only. The Chicago link is not feasible: the host is not allowlisted and its licence is unknown.
